description: This file contains multiple trading strategies and backtesting functions for stock data analysis, including indicator calculations, strategy implementations, parameter sweeps, and performance evaluation.

methods.name: get_stock_backtest_data
methods.description: Fetches historical stock data for a given ticker and date range, with a buffer period for analysis.

methods.name: strategy_KeltnerChannel_origin
methods.description: Implements a trading strategy based on Keltner Channel indicator signals.

methods.name: strategy_BollingerBands
methods.description: Implements a trading strategy based on Bollinger Bands indicator signals.

methods.name: strategy_MA
methods.description: Implements a moving average crossover trading strategy with configurable MA type.

methods.name: strategy_WR
methods.description: Implements a Williams %R indicator-based trading strategy.

methods.name: strategy_Stochastic_fast
methods.description: Implements a stochastic oscillator-based trading strategy.

methods.name: strategy_Stochastic_slow
methods.description: Implements a slow stochastic oscillator-based trading strategy with additional smoothing.

methods.name: strategy_Ichmoku
methods.description: Implements a trading strategy based on Ichimoku Cloud indicator signals.

methods.name: prepare_stock_ta_backtest_data
methods.description: Prepares backtest data by applying a selected strategy and filtering by date range.

methods.name: run_stock_ta_backtest
methods.description: Executes backtest simulation on prepared data, including position management, stop-loss, and performance metrics.
